As a first step, you should update to neovim 0.3.1,it's been released some days ago, and in particular of course includes all the fixes that went into 0.3 over .2.2, which is quite a lot.

Ok, I think the devs need to come in :) Your `$TERM` looks funky, though, could you try `xterm-256color`? I'm not sure about alacritty (I'm not even sure this is important), but for xterm you could give `TERM=xterm` a shot.

Oh wait, you're not on a release, silly me. There have been changes to the UI representation, bugs are kind of expected in HEAD right now. I'm sure detailed reports are appreciated, but you will probably have to resort to 0.3.1 for the time being.

issue.title: [RFC] tui: clip invalid regions on resize

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body:
Hotfix for #8774. This TUI logic could use some simplification/refactor here, such as just storing invalid segment per line instead of intersecting rectangles logic, but I'll might look into that when back from travelling.

Also later on, there is no fundamental reason for not just redrawing as usual on resize in message mode (which could include reflow), there is aldready some logic for redisplaying messages, as used by the builting pager.
